links.outcome: Accuracy of variant interpretation answers with vs without database-retrieval grounding, versus comparators
links.effect: ChatTogoVar (RAG grounded in TogoVar) achieved the highest score for 135/150 questions, outperforming a general-purpose LLM and a specialized system; LLM scoring of all 1500 questions confirmed the trend.
links.quote: ChatTogoVar achieved the highest score for 135/150 questions, outperforming both a general-purpose LLM and an existing specialized system.

screen.reason: Evaluates adding retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounding with a variant database (TogoVar) to an LLM to mitigate hallucinations in genomic variant interpretation, compared against base general-purpose LLM.
